releases.title: More funding and events, clearer reading, one-click updates
notes: Funding brews work again in the browser after a change on Grants.gov.
Funding now matches your country: NIH Guide for the US, EU Funding & Tenders (Horizon Europe, ERC, MSCA) for Europe.
Events now include EMBO workshops and courses worldwide, and every upcoming EMBL event.
Journal names are written out in full and lead each card; compact view is fixed.
Updates now say what changed and install with one click.
